readingTips.日: Alone it is ひ (day) or び in 日曜日; in compounds it is usually ニチ.
readingTips.月: Months of the year use ガツ (一月 いちがつ); "this month" uses ゲツ; the moon itself is つき.
readingTips.一: Counting uses イチ; "one thing" is ひとつ and "one person" is ひとり.
readingTips.人: Nationalities use ジン (日本人); counting people uses ニン (三人); alone it is ひと.
readingTips.四: Say よん in most numbers (四十 よんじゅう); し appears in 四月 しがつ.
readingTips.七: Both しち and なな are used; なな is clearer on the phone.
readingTips.九: キュウ in most numbers; ク in 九月 くがつ.
readingTips.大: ダイ in 大学; タイ in 大会; おお- in words like 大きい.
readingTips.生: This kanji has many readings: セイ in 学生, う(まれる) "be born", い(きる) "live", なま "raw".
readingTips.行: い(く) "go" is the one to learn first; ギョウ is "a line of text", コウ appears in 銀行.
readingTips.下: した "below"; さ(げる)/くだ(る) for lowering or going down; カ/ゲ in compounds.
readingTips.上: うえ "above"; あ(がる) "go up"; ジョウ in compounds like 上手.
readingTips.後: ゴ in 午後; うし(ろ) "behind"; あと "after".
readingTips.何: なに before most sounds; なん before d, n and t sounds and counters (何時 なんじ).

mnemonics.一: One finger laid flat: a single line means one.
mnemonics.二: Two fingers laid flat, the bottom one a little longer: two.
mnemonics.三: Three lines stacked like three fingers held sideways: three.
mnemonics.四: A box with legs inside: four walls holding a pair of legs. Think of a four-poster bed.
mnemonics.五: Two lines with a zigzag between them, like a crooked 5 lying on a shelf: five.
mnemonics.六: A little hat on top and two legs below: six is a person in a hat doing the splits.
mnemonics.七: An upside-down 7 with a line through it: seven.
mnemonics.八: Two strokes spreading apart like the bottom of a skirt or a mountain path: eight.
mnemonics.九: An arm reaching out with a hooked elbow: nine looks like a strong arm flexing.
mnemonics.十: A cross: count to ten on your fingers and cross them.
mnemonics.百: One (一) on top of white (白): one white sheet holds a hundred grains of rice.
mnemonics.千: Ten (十) with a slash on top: a thousand is ten with a stroke of extra effort.
mnemonics.日: A window with one bar: you see the sun through it every day.
mnemonics.月: A crescent moon leaning to the side with two clouds across it.
mnemonics.火: A person (人) with sparks flying out on both sides: fire.
mnemonics.水: A central stream with splashes flicking off left and right: water.
mnemonics.木: A trunk with one branch across and two roots spreading below: a tree.
mnemonics.金: A roof over a mine shaft, with two gold nuggets glinting in the earth.
mnemonics.土: A small cross planted on a long line of ground: soil.
mnemonics.山: Three peaks, the middle one tallest: a mountain.
mnemonics.川: Three lines of water running side by side: a river.
mnemonics.天: A person standing with arms out (大) under one line: the sky above everyone.
mnemonics.気: Steam rising in wavy lines over a pot, with an X of energy inside: spirit and air.
mnemonics.雨: A window or sky frame with raindrops falling inside: rain.
mnemonics.子: A baby wrapped up with arms reaching out: child.
mnemonics.女: A woman kneeling with crossed legs and arms gracefully folded.
mnemonics.男: A rice field (田) above power (力): the man works in the field.
mnemonics.父: Two crossed tools under a pair of marks: father with his tools crossed, ready to work.
mnemonics.母: A woman shape with two dots for a mother nursing her baby.
mnemonics.大: A person (人) stretching their arms wide: big!
mnemonics.小: A small hook with a dot on each side: tiny bits scattering, small.
mnemonics.中: A line straight through the middle of a box: middle, inside.
mnemonics.上: A line pointing up from the ground: above, up.
mnemonics.下: A line hanging down from the ceiling: below, down.
mnemonics.右: A hand reaching over a mouth (口): you eat with your right hand.
mnemonics.左: A hand holding a carpenter's square (工): the left hand holds the tool.
mnemonics.東: The sun (日) rising behind a tree (木): east, where the sun comes up.
mnemonics.西: A bird settling into its nest at sunset: west.
mnemonics.南: A tent with a cross on top and a warm fire below: south, where it is warm.
mnemonics.北: Two people sitting back to back, turning away from the cold north wind.
mnemonics.外: Evening (夕) plus a fortune-telling stick (卜): going outside at night to read the stars.
mnemonics.年: A person carrying a big bundle of rice: a year's harvest.
mnemonics.時: The sun (日) beside a temple (寺): the temple bell tells the time.
mnemonics.間: The sun (日) shining through a gate (門): the space between the doors.
mnemonics.午: A cow (牛) without its horn sticking up: noon, when even the cow rests.
mnemonics.前: Horns on top, flesh (月) and a knife (刂): the butcher works in front of you.
mnemonics.後: Small steps (彳) and a thread with a slow foot: walking behind, after.
mnemonics.今: A roof over a single line: right now, under this roof.
mnemonics.毎: A person wearing a hat over mother (母): every mother, every day.
mnemonics.半: Two horns on top and a cross cut in half: half.
mnemonics.何: A person (亻) next to "can" (可): what can a person do?
mnemonics.万: One (一) over a hook like a pen flourish: ten thousand.
mnemonics.円: A round window frame: a circle, and the round yen coin.
mnemonics.行: A crossroads split in two (彳 + 亍): go along the road.
mnemonics.来: A tree (木) with rice grains blowing in: next year's rice is coming.
mnemonics.出: Two mountains (山) stacked: climb out over the peaks.
mnemonics.入: A person (人) leaning forward to enter through a doorway.
mnemonics.休: A person (亻) leaning against a tree (木): rest.
mnemonics.車: A cart seen from above: wheel, axle and body. Car.
mnemonics.学: A child (子) under a roof with sparks of ideas above: study.
mnemonics.校: A tree (木) beside people mixing (交): school under the trees.
mnemonics.先: A person with legs (儿) walking out in front: ahead, previous.
mnemonics.生: A plant sprouting from the earth: life, to be born.
mnemonics.友: Two hands reaching across to each other: friend.
mnemonics.名: Evening (夕) and a mouth (口): in the dark you call out your name.
mnemonics.見: An eye (目) on legs (儿): going to see.
mnemonics.聞: An ear (耳) at a gate (門): listening at the door.
mnemonics.話: Words (言) and a tongue (舌): talking.
mnemonics.語: Words (言) and "I" (吾): the words I speak, a language.
mnemonics.読: Words (言) and sell (売): a seller reading out the words.
mnemonics.書: A hand holding a brush (聿) over the sun (日): writing all day.
mnemonics.国: A jewel (玉) inside borders (囗): a country's treasure.
mnemonics.本: A tree (木) with a line at the root: the origin, and books made from trees.
mnemonics.高: A tall tower with a roof, a window and a door: tall, expensive.
mnemonics.白: The sun (日) with a ray shining on top: white light.
mnemonics.電: Rain (雨) above a field with a lightning tail: electricity.
mnemonics.食: A roof (人) over good food: eat.
